# Square Lipstick Organizer

![Render](render.png)

## Description
This is a parametric 3D model for a lipstick organizer specifically designed to hold square lipsticks perfectly. The grid layout keeps your makeup collection neat, accessible, and upright.

## Try it out
To modify the model or print an STL/3MF file, you can view this live in the OpenSCAD playground by following this link:
[OpenSCAD Playground](https://ochafik.com/openscad2/#)
